issuing_body: Ministry of Science and ICT (과학기술정보통신부) / National Information Society Agency (NIA)
covered_actors: AI development business operators (인공지능개발사업자) developing and providing AI systems meeting all three cumulative statutory criteria under AI Basic Act Article 32 and Enforcement Decree Article 24(1)

AI business operators (인공지능사업자) making substantial modifications (실질적 변경) to existing AI systems causing them to meet Enforcement Decree Article 24(1) criteria or materially altering their risk characteristics
Overseas AI development business operators and their designated domestic representatives (국외 소재 개발 사업자 및 국내대리인)
Internal multidisciplinary risk-assessment organizations (위험평가조직) and safety-incident response organizations (안전사고 대응 조직) led by Chief AI Officers (CAIO) or Chief AI Safety Officers (CAISO)
Non-covered AI business operators voluntarily referencing the guideline to build autonomous risk management systems

enforcement_authorities: Ministry of Science and ICT (과학기술정보통신부 / MSIT)
Korea AI Safety Institute (인공지능안전연구소 / Korea AISI, referenced for submission consultation and specialized verification)
Korea Internet & Security Agency (한국인터넷진흥원 / KISA, referenced under Network Act Article 48-3 cyber-incident reporting)
compliance_deadlines: Within 3 months of recognizing applicability under Enforcement Decree Art. 24(1): Initial written submission of safety assurance measures (Draft Notice Arts. 4–7) to MSIT
Within 1 month of substantial modification increasing risk or recognizing a new risk: Supplemental safety assurance submission to MSIT (extendable via prior MSIT consultation for unavoidable reasons)
Within 24 hours of awareness of an AI safety incident: Initial incident report to MSIT
Within 7 days of initial incident report: Initial response-action report to MSIT
Within 15 days of initial incident report: Final incident-handling, root-cause, residual-risk, and recurrence-prevention report to MSIT
Every 3 years from 2026-07-01 (by June 30 of each third year): Scheduled MSIT validity review of the Public Notice (Draft Notice Art. 9)
implementation_notes: 75-page consultation draft guideline (인공지능 안전성 확보 가이드라인(안)) operationalizing AI Basic Act Article 32, Enforcement Decree Article 24, and Draft MSIT Public Notice No. 2026-126 (2026.2.) for frontier AI systems meeting three cumulative triggers: (1) cumulative training compute >= 10^26 FLOPs, (2) state-of-the-art (SOTA) AI technology, and (3) potential for widespread and serious impact on human life, physical safety, and fundamental rights. Covers compute estimation/verification, substantial-modification liability (e.g., >=1/3 parameter retraining, systematic fine-tuning, or autonomous execution integration), 6-step lifecycle risk identification, 7-step risk evaluation by an independent multidisciplinary organization, multi-layer mitigation and emergency response plans, CAIO/CAISO-led incident response and staff training, 3-month/1-month compliance filings (with domestic representative option for offshore developers), and 24-hour/7-day/15-day three-stage safety incident reporting. Explicitly marked as a draft subject to change prior to final release.
